scope: Exploratory Linux RTX 4090 comparison; not the Apple M3 Max migration decision

runtime.ort: 2.0.0-rc.13; TensorRT registration failed (libnvinfer.so.10 absent); CUDA registered; profile 38/38 nodes CUDA
runtime.tch: 0.24.0, libtorch/PyTorch 2.11.0+cu128; CUDA convolutions with TF32 disabled
runtime.ort_cuda_libraries: nvidia-cublas 13.0.2.14 and nvidia-cuda-runtime 13.0.96, isolated in experiment directory
runtime.shared_gpu: Ollama occupied about 10868 MiB and Comfy about 386 MiB throughout the initial check

serial_frames_after_warmup.api_timing_boundary: ORT Session::run includes host-to-device input transfer; tch infer excludes it because frame loading and host-to-device transfer are recorded as preprocess. Both include synchronized output readback. Only total_fps includes all input adaptation on both sides.

quality_cross_machine_control.note: Cross-machine final-video comparison includes post-inference platform differences and is not the Linux candidate gate

limitations: Only two paired 5-second runs, not five 3-minute pairs or full-video verification
GPU was shared with pre-existing processes; timings include unrelated scheduling effects
End-to-end difference mostly reflects CPU postprocessing and PNG I/O, not CUDA inference
No cross-machine speed comparison with the Apple M3 Max results
